title: EHAL Setpoint-API (schema_version 4)
description: Design C1: ESS active_power (signed W) + true charge/discharge limits + optional mode hint + source select (2.7.h). EVCS currents in A. At least one setpoint field required. Field names: docs/ui/ehal-com.md §C.

set_ess_active_power.description: Forced ESS active power in W (+discharge, −charge). Omit on Automatik.

set_ess_charge_power_limit.description: Max ESS charge power in W (magnitude; true cap).

set_ess_discharge_power_limit.description: Max ESS discharge power in W (magnitude; true cap).

set_ess_mode.description: Optional ESS mode hint for Loxone/HA (e.g. Huawei control_cmd). OpenEMS ignores.

set_ess_source_select.description: Route locally-attached consumers: 0 = grid pass-through (charge allowed), 1 = battery-only island (no AC charge). Live wire is Pattern B ess.{id}.set_ess_source_select on physical standby_backup (2.7.h); omit for house ESS / plant.

set_evcs_max_current.description: EV charge current setpoint / max current in A.

set_evcs_mode.description: EV charge mode: off (idle/absent/complete), pv (PV-follow), or now (immediate).

set_grid_export_power_limit.description: Max grid export power in W (non-negative magnitude). 0 = no export; unconstrained = plant maximum (PV kWp + force-discharge ESS kW), fallback 1000000.
